# AI Usage Battery 0.2.6 (Build 10)
This release updates Codex tracking for the unified ChatGPT usage model, where Codex now reports a single weekly limit instead of separate 5-hour and weekly windows.
## Changes
- Reads the current Codex weekly limit from single-window remote and local rate-limit payloads. - Classifies local Codex rate-limit events by their reported window duration instead of assuming primary means 5 hours. - Removes the obsolete Codex 5-hour meter from the menu bar, popover, settings, cache, and notifications. - Keeps Claude's existing 5-hour and weekly display options unchanged. - Uses the common weekly window when Codex and Claude are displayed together. - Updates onboarding, diagnostics, and documentation for the new provider-specific window model.
## Verification
- Verified the current local Codex event shape reports a 10,080-minute primary window with no secondary window. - Swift test suite passes with 39 tests. - Xcode Debug app build passes.
